text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Page triggered for prod-AZ1a: high 5xx rate observed on inference fleet and controlplane heartbeats failing, auto-escalate to on-call.
alice_sre: seeing ~30% of g5 instances in AZ1a reporting network RX drops, TCP retransmits spike. hitting backend LB health checks.
ben_network: confirming, VPC flow logs show increased RSTs and short-lived connections to the ENI range in AZ1a. Suspect partial NIC offload degradation or host-level queue saturation.
carla_runtime: traffic shows many in-flight KV cache misses, model loads hanging for 200-400ms. Downstreams report token latencies jumping. Not universal but affects steady-state inference load.
dave_support: customer telemetry: multiple PROD customers reporting 504s for generate endpoints, roughly 12 customers with elevated errors, some timeouts P50->P99. Logging forwarded to SSO.
elena_pm: any ETA on mitigation? Customers asking for updates — need a short statement for status page.
alice_sre: immediate mitigation plan: 1) divert new traffic away from AZ1a by updating routing policy to prefer AZ1b/c; 2) scale up warm standby in AZ1b, enable cross-AZ sticky session fallback; 3) drain degraded hosts in AZ1a. Starting step 1 now.
ben_network: doing route update — changing smart-routing policy to region-prefer then AZ fallback. Will patch routing table in control plane. Expected propagation ~30s-2m.
carla_runtime: adding temporary model-variant fallback for affected hosts to reduce KV contention (force use of local quantized variant). Pushing rollout to canary then all.
alice_sre: drain command sent to node-controller for AZ1a group g5-prod-az1a: `kubectl cordon node-az1a-* && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
carla_runtime: note: draining will trigger model shard relocations; enabling aggressive prefetch to reduce cold starts.
ben_network: route flip in progress — control plane confirming traffic shift. Early metrics show error rate dropping in AZ1a from 30%->10% in 90s.
dave_support: posting interim update to customers: "We detected networking degradation in a single AWS AZ affecting inference requests; we're diverting traffic to healthy AZs and scaling capacity. Some requests may see increased latency. We'll post another update in 15 minutes."
elena_pm: add note: "No data plane exfiltration suspected, this is connectivity/egress related."
carla_runtime: telemetry: KV cache miss rate normalized for sessions moved to AZ1b, but some long tail model-load errors remain for older sessions pinned to AZ1a. Working on session rebind sweep.
achris_oncall: I'm coming on for handoff in 10m. Alice, can you capture runbook steps and any blockers before I take over?
alice_sre: recording notes: root cause suspected host NIC offload + ENI queue backlog. Actions taken: updated routing policy, cordoned/drained nodes, model fallback deployed, customers notified, scale up in AZ1b + AZ1c. No immediate config rollback needed.
ben_network: additional finding: internal DNS resolver (VPC resolver) in AZ1a showing high query latency — likely contributing to controlplane heartbeats. We saw a cache spillover when many ephemeral clients re-resolved local addresses after RST storms.
carla_runtime: created a temporary host-level override to use cross-AZ resolver endpoint for controlplane heartbeats: set env REDWOOD_RESOLVER=az-global-resolver for canary pods. Rolling to 10% now.
dave_support: tracking impacted customers by org id, pinging top 5 SLAs for customer-facing comms.
achris_oncall: taking over — Alice, I'll keep the reroute until we confirm AZ1a healthy and then revert routing policy gradually. If we see error rates <1% for 10m, we'll start safe-reintroduce.
alice_sre: acknowledged handoff. If NIC counters don't return to baseline within 30m we should open a cloud support case and consider instance replacement/retire for the host pool.
ben_network: opening AWS case with EC2 networking team, attaching flow logs and host counters. Case ref: 12345-az1a-net.
carla_runtime: also kicking off post-incident eval: capture KV cache eviction metrics, model startup latencies, and per-route SLA. Will create an eval prompt set to check quality regressions from fallback variant.
elena_pm: thanks. I'll prepare a short status page update and coordinate with growth/start.
dave_support: will keep customers updated and collect any production logs from their side.
achris_oncall: plan for next 60m: monitor error rates, DNS resolver latency, ENI RX/TX queue depth, hand back to Alice for postmortem. If necessary, plan maintenance window for host replacement.
alice_sre: final quick note: no indications of data loss, traffic diverted successfully, partial impact lasted ~12m peak. Will start timeline later. :white_check_mark:"
